rule_updates: R1 (loop A): every cited evidence URL must resolve (<400, reachable host) from the verifier; deep links are high-churn — prefer section roots.

R2 (loop B): 'official MCP' claims require either (a) a host-domain endpoint that speaks JSON-RPC (401-with-jsonrpc counts), or (b) a first-party announcement/repo. Docs-hosting catch-alls (Stoplight, Redocly, SPA shells, generic 405s) do NOT count — 3 loop-A probe positives were false.

R3 (loop B): auth families are scheme-level (OAuth2 / Basic / OAuth1 / HMAC / static-key / jwt / bot-token). A credential used inside a scheme (API key as Basic password) is not an extra scheme; family synonyms {API key, Token} collapse for scoring.
R4 (human): name-collision check is mandatory for generic product names (Consensus vs goConsensus; Pylon vs pylon.page; iPayX vs iPay Africa). Two collisions found in this set.
R5 (human): claims that cannot be checked against any observable source are marked unscorable/low-confidence — never rubber-stamped.
